description: Line 711–712: 'UniversalString (UCS-4 BE) — decode + normalize in v0.2' assumes character-by-character decode. UCS-4 can encode surrogates (U+D800–U+DFFF, invalid in Unicode) and out-of-range codepoints (>U+10FFFF). The v0.2 implementer needs: (1) explicit handling rules for invalid codepoints (reject, replace with U+FFFD, skip?), (2) clarification that BMP subset check doesn't apply to UniversalString (unlike BMPString). Add: 'Note: reject or replace invalid UCS-4 sequences per [policy TBD].'
